directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: What other discounts, I got enough problems here...
entries.JA_current: What other discounts, I got enough problems here...
entries.JA_new: 他にどんな割引だ？ こっちは問題だらけなんだぞ……

entries.EN: Everybody brings you artifacts, you don't even have to go to the Zone, what else do you need?
entries.JA_current: Everybody brings you artifacts, you don't even have to go to the Zone, what else do you need?
entries.JA_new: みんなアーティファクトを持ってきてくれる。ゾーンに行く必要すらないんだろ？ それなのに何が問題なんだ？

entries.EN: It's not that simple, stalker! You think commerce is safe? No, it isn't. The bandits found out I was selling gear and decided to charge me a percentage. I've been on the meter for a long time, and the fee is growing every day.
entries.JA_current: It's not that simple, stalker! You think commerce is safe? No, it isn't. The bandits found out I was selling gear and decided to charge me a percentage. I've been on the meter for a long time, and the fee is growing every day.
entries.JA_new: そんな簡単な話じゃない、ストーカー。商売が安全だと思うか？ 違う。バンディットに装備を売ってるのがばれて、売上の一部をよこせと言われた。ずっと取り立てられてるが、要求額は日に日に増えてる。

entries.EN: Wait a minute, you've got loan sharks after you? Why don't you pack up and run?
entries.JA_current: Wait a minute, you've got loan sharks after you? Why don't you pack up and run?
entries.JA_new: 待てよ、借金取りに追われてるのか？ 店を畳んで逃げればいいだろ？

entries.EN: I would have ran, but the bandits warned me that if I did, they would kill me. You see, here in the Zone, the rules are not the same as in the outside world. If I went to the police there, for example, I would be given some security at the very least, but here - every man for himself. The Debtors have enough to worry about, not like they're gonna come and break my kneecaps for not paying them faster. Besides, I value my life, so I'm not about to play hide and seek with them. Even here, in the Bar, I can't be completely safe from their hitmen, and if I leave the Bar, I am gonna be walking right into the lion's maw, so to speak.
entries.JA_current: I would have ran, but the bandits warned me that if I did, they would kill me. You see, here in the Zone, the rules are not the same as in the outside world. If I went to the police there, for example, I would be given some security at the very least, but here - every man for himself. The Debtors have enough to worry about, not like they're gonna come and break my kneecaps for not paying them faster. Besides, I value my life, so I'm not about to play hide and seek with them. Even here, in the Bar, I can't be completely safe from their hitmen, and if I leave the Bar, I am gonna be walking right into the lion's maw, so to speak.
entries.JA_new: 逃げたかったさ。だが逃げたら殺すとバンディットに脅された。ゾーンの中は、外の世界と決まりが違うんだ。外なら警察に行けば、少なくとも護衛くらいつけてもらえる。だがここじゃ、誰も助けてくれない。借金取りにも他に気にかけることはあるし、支払いが遅いからってすぐ膝を砕きに来るわけじゃない。それに命が惜しいから、連中とかくれんぼをする気はない。バーの中にいても殺し屋から完全に身を守れるわけじゃないし、外へ出たらライオンの口に飛び込むようなもんだ。

entries.EN: How much do you owe them now?
entries.JA_current: How much do you owe them now?
entries.JA_new: 今はいくら借りてるんだ？

entries.EN: Ten thousand to each of the Gladiators.
entries.JA_current: Ten thousand to each of the Gladiators.
entries.JA_new: グラディエーターの連中一人につき、1万だ。
